summary.headline: Neosem Inc. signs KRW 14.2bn semiconductor test equipment supply contract, 22.2% of recent revenue
summary.what_happened: On Nov 24, 2026, Neosem Inc. disclosed a single supply contract for semiconductor test equipment, including GEN6 SSD Tester, with a counterparty, NEOSEM TECHNOLOGY INC., a subsidiary of the company. The contract is for overseas supply, runs from Nov 24, 2026 to Jun 30, 2027, and is not conditional; the filing states no advance payment and payment is due within 60 days after delivery and inspection are completed.
summary.why_it_matters: Supply contracts disclosed under Korean exchange rules are typically reported when they are material relative to a company's revenue, giving shareholders information on the size and timing of expected sales. Actual revenue recognition depends on delivery, inspection and payment, and the stated end date may change.
